tara: integration matrix on master is red — nightly/features-integration -> scaffold-diff failed in axis 'py38-integration'. Can someone do a light resubmit for just that axis and avoid rebuilding images? /cc @mike

mike: on it. you can run:```
ci rerun --job 'scaffold-diff[py38-integration]' --skip-image --preserve-cache
```this should skip image rebuild and keep the build cache.

ci-bot: Queued rerun: job scaffold-diff[py38-integration] retriggered by mike. build id: build-2103459001

jia: fyi if it flakes repeatedly we should bisect the regressing commit. quick bisect command:```
ci bisect --job 'scaffold-diff[py38-integration]' --since 2026-03-01 --until HEAD
```

tara: thanks. also can we ensure the KV cache is preserved? last time we lost cache and it added ~3m to the run.

mike: good call — added --preserve-cache above. kicking it off now.

ci-bot: Started: build-2103459001 on runner gpu-dedicated-3. Logs: https://ci.redwood/invocations/build-2103459001

praveen: if the rerun fails again, open a bisect ticket and tag #eng-infra — sometimes that test is order-dependent and needs a localized fix.

tara: :thumbsup: i'll watch the logs. ping me if it stays red for >10m.

tara: nice, thanks everyone. closing this thread.
